Which abilities in this counselling work are worth verifying first?

First verify whether you can listen without rushing to judge, record service progress faithfully, maintain material boundaries and cooperate with authorized professionals. Also assess whether sustained contact with difficult situations and the documentation burden are bearable; one exercise does not prove that you can take on real counselling.
This is a career exploration prompt, not a clinical assessment or a hiring conclusion. Legal authority, education and supervision requirements must be checked against the location and institution.

Observable signals include: after hearing a request, restating it accurately and not adding guesses to the record; keeping unconfirmed arrangements as pending; knowing what colleagues need and distinguishing necessary cooperation from casual forwarding. When revisions come, you are willing to locate the original sentence, remove the overreaching conclusion and explain the basis for the change. You can also state honestly which tasks you have not been trained for and accept supervision rather than promising a treatment effect to look capable.

First check the real conditions: whether you are willing to keep records and follow up, whether you can accept fluctuating progress, and whether the institution has clear supervision, scheduling and referral responsibility. If you only like giving advice but find it hard to listen to different views, or understand helping others as making every decision for them, observe with specific tasks first. Do not diagnose a service user from your own experience, and do not let occupational interest make you ignore your own emotional recovery and authority boundaries.

Record whether the eight judgments have a basis in the original text, how the two versions of the summary keep the unknowns, and whether you are willing to keep accurate records. Then choose one learning task that can give professional feedback, and do not let one exercise decide lifelong fit.

The US identity basis is O*NET-SOC 21-1011.00; the work includes individual, group or family counselling and planning and progress records. Psychology, family therapy and rehabilitation counselling each have their own task scope, and participating in the same service team does not automatically make the authority the same.

The input includes the service user's own account, existing records, team information and the explicit service objective. The information source, timing and items still to be confirmed should be distinguished, and fluent guesses must not be treated as verified facts.

O*NET describes developing a plan based on the individual's background and needs, setting measurable goals and reviewing progress. The actual plan is made by trained personnel within institutional authority, and the exercise on this page only checks record facts and does not train readers to design a treatment plan.

The output includes case records, stage progress, the service plan and follow-up arrangements. The record should show what was provided, what the objective was and who confirms the next step, and must not write a referral whose reply has not arrived as completed.

The service setting may involve outpatient, inpatient, community or residential facilities. The handover, record system and accessible materials differ, and the scope of application and responsible person should be confirmed with the institution.

Frequent cooperation with physicians, nurses, social workers and other counsellors is required. Questions go to the person responsible for that task and authorized for it; cooperation does not mean anyone can access the complete health record.

Professional activities also include training, case discussion and follow-up service. Continuous learning and supervision are needed; course certificates, general communication ability and actual practice authority are checked separately.

After the service or stage ends there are still records, follow-up arrangements and material handling responsibilities. Public work samples use only explicitly fictional materials, and a real case does not automatically become showable material just because the name is removed.

Counselling services and resource referral are two connected lines of work. The following is an editorial process organized from O*NET tasks, not a clinical procedure or statutory process that can be applied directly.
Counselling services and progress records
Check the duties → Understand the account → Negotiate goals → Provide the service within authority → Record progress → Supervisory review
A record that traces the information source, the service content and the items to be confirmed
Resource referral and service linkage
Confirm the need → Check the resource → Confirm the information scope → Coordinate contact → Follow up the status → Keep the result
A linkage record stating the contact, the application status and the responsibility for the next step
Shared professional foundation
Active listening · faithful records · goal review · team collaboration · privacy protection · authority boundaries
What is the difference between counselling services and resource referral?

Counselling services focus on assisting change and reviewing progress within the professional scope; referral focuses on linking the need to an applicable resource and following up the status. Both need accurate records, but sending an application must not be taken as having received the service, and being able to coordinate resources does not mean claiming treatment ability.
Core purpose
Within the licensed and trained scope, help the service user understand the problem, set goals and follow up change.
Help link the need to a resource and clarify the application, reply and follow-up service status.
Main object and basis
The service user's own account, existing materials, individual background, negotiated goals and professional feedback.
Resource conditions, institutional contacts, the shareable information scope and confirmed contact records.
Core process
Understand the need, form goals, provide the corresponding service, record changes and accept professional review.
Check the applicable resource, coordinate contact, follow up the reply and record arrangements not yet implemented.
Main output
Case records, a service plan and stage progress, keeping the original source and the uncertain parts.
A resource note, a linkage record, the items to be confirmed and the division of responsibility for the next step.
Responsible party
Counsellors are responsible within institutional duties, training level and local authority; diagnostic and treatment authority is checked separately.
The person carrying out the referral coordination is responsible for the status being accurate, and the receiving institution is responsible for its service and professional judgment.
Coordination method
Discuss appropriate service cooperation with other counsellors, physicians, nurses and social workers.
Check the contact progress with the resource institution and the team to avoid duplicate promises or missed replies.
Delivery boundaries
The US tasks in the occupational profile do not mean that a psychological counsellor in China may diagnose or treat.
Submitting an application, receiving a reply and confirming an appointment are different statuses and do not substitute for one another.
Key occupational judgments

First judge the information source, the service status and the authority, then decide how the record should be expressed. The following are editorial exploration questions, not a diagnostic scale or a professional handling instruction.
Which parts of the record are the person's own account and which are confirmed process facts?
Is the service objective clearly written, and is the progress supported by actual records?
Between sending the application and confirming the appointment, is the receiving party's reply still missing?
Which fact, status or wording is the supervisor asking to revise?

Locate the feedback to the original sentence and the corresponding record and separately correct the unsupported inference and the overreaching status. Keep the reasons for the changes so the next reader can see how far confirmation has gone.
Have the material purpose and the receiving scope been confirmed?

First confirm the institutional authority, the task need and the information scope. When this cannot be confirmed, check with the responsible staff, and do not treat working together once or a single conversation as permission to forward the complete case freely.
After the stage ends, which follow-ups, records and responsibilities remain to be confirmed?

Understanding｜Listening and material checking｜Understand the need and background the service user expresses and distinguish their account, existing records and professional opinion, avoiding a premature conclusion.
Planning｜Goals and service arrangements｜Within the trained and licensed scope, form measurable goals with the relevant people and review the plan as progress occurs.
Service｜Individual and group communication｜Provide the corresponding counselling or support under institutional duties, attending to expression, understanding and continued participation.
Records｜Service and progress documentation｜Record the service content, timing and progress faithfully, keeping the information source and the items to be confirmed.
Collaboration｜Case discussion and referral｜Work with counsellors, physicians, nurses and social workers, coordinate applicable resources and follow up the status.
Professional development｜Training and follow-up service｜Attend training, accept professional feedback, arrange follow-up and check authority and material responsibility.
Section title｜Work environment and working method

The US materials list outpatient and residential service facilities, hospitals, mental health centres and correctional settings. Many jobs are full time and some are part time or require night and weekend work; the specific service and scheduling depend on the institution.

Common organizations and sites｜Outpatient centres, hospitals, residential facilities, community and other service organizations have different working conditions. Chinese community drug rehabilitation social work announcements can illustrate an adjacent service environment, but all posts cannot therefore be called counsellor or medical posts.

Work materials and tools｜Case and progress records, service goals, resource information, appointment status and team feedback are common work inputs. Electronic systems, paper documentation and office tools serve records and collaboration; owning software or course materials does not prove practice authority.

Organization｜Individual, group or family services coexist with team collaboration. The responsible person and material access authority for each task should be checked, and a personal opinion must not be written as a decision the team has confirmed.

Scheduling and burden｜BLS describes that some jobs may involve night or weekend work, and contact with difficult situations, workload and resource limits may cause stress. The actual shifts, number of service users and recovery time must be asked of the target institution, without inventing a uniform daily caseload or working time.

Coordination and communication｜Tell colleagues the confirmed facts, the material sources, the replies not yet received and the responsibility for the next step; listen first and then restate, and do not use a vague already handled to hide the real status.

Review and responsibility｜O*NET lists case discussion, cooperation with professionals and progress review tasks. Specific questions are confirmed under institutional supervision and referral arrangements; a reader of this page does not take on real crisis judgment, diagnosis or treatment based on a fictional exercise.

Quality requirements｜The observable quality is accurate information, a clear status, traceable goals and progress, respectful communication and clear authority. Service effectiveness cannot be assumed just because the summary reads smoothly; whether it is acceptable still requires actual training, supervision and professional evaluation.

Substance abuse and behavioural disorder counsellors provide individual, family or group counselling for alcohol, tobacco, drug and other behavioural problems, develop and review service plans, record progress and coordinate referrals. This is the US O*NET duty statement; when taking on psychological counselling, social work or medical tasks in China, the institutional duties and legal authority must each be checked.
US clinical and counselling psychologists cover psychological assessment, the corresponding diagnosis and service tasks; this requires professional preparation and licensing in the target direction.
Marriage and family therapists focus on partner and family relationships, service plans and progress, and require training and licensing in that direction.
The local health counsellor corresponds to Mental Health Counselors and focuses on mental health services, not nutrition or general health advice in the broad sense.
Rehabilitation counsellors coordinate resources around independent living, employment barriers and rehabilitation plans, and the task focus differs from substance abuse counselling.
Counselling services and progress records
Within the corresponding duties, understand the need and provide counselling or support and record the goals and progress.
Part of this occupation's tasks, but the authority and training conditions differ by institution, population and jurisdiction and must be checked separately.
Willing to listen over the long term, keep accurate records and accept professional supervision.
Resource referral and service linkage
Check the applicable conditions of the resource, coordinate contact and follow up the reply and service status.
Focuses on linkage; providing public information does not mean treatment, an appointment or the service has been completed.
Likes checking materials, coordinating resources and keeping the unconfirmed status.
Clinical and counselling psychologists
The task shifts to psychological assessment and the corresponding professional services, and professional authority is not obtained automatically from counselling experience.
Willing to check study, supervised practice and licensing separately for the target profession.
Marriage and family therapists
A professional service focused on partner and family relationships; good communication alone does not qualify someone to move into it.
Willing to add training in that direction and check the corresponding working conditions.
Health counsellor (mental health counselling direction)
The English identity is Mental Health Counselors; it focuses on mental health services, different from general health advice.
Wants to understand broader mental health tasks and is willing to check the training and licensing.
Rehabilitation counsellors
Rehabilitation planning and resource coordination aimed at independent living and employment barriers require the corresponding task preparation.
Willing to coordinate support around personal goals and real barriers.
How should counselling, referral and adjacent occupations be chosen?

First separate this occupation's counselling and coordination tasks, then look at the separate occupational identities of psychology, family therapy, mental health and rehabilitation counselling. They may serve the same population, but the delivery focus and licensing differ; career exploration should compare the tasks you are willing to keep doing and the preparation still needed. The US profile does not directly establish Chinese job qualifications.

If you prefer listening, following up and faithful recording, start with the F1 documentation experience; if you prefer resource coordination, practise checking conditions and status. When moving to psychology, family therapy or rehabilitation, demonstrate preparation with the target tasks and professional training, and do not infer automatic competence from the name or years. One exploration only narrows the direction and still requires checking institutional conditions.

All four adjacent directions read their separate O*NET profiles, keeping the local frozen names and target links. The work directions and fit prompts are an editorial summary; US tasks do not equal Chinese practice authority, and individual preparation requires real training and jobs.
After choosing a direction, distinguish whether AI affects the draft, actual adoption or the employment outcome, keeping the professional responsibility and material boundaries.

description.text: Substance abuse and behavioural disorder counsellors help people facing alcohol, drug and other behavioural problems through individual or group counselling, service plans, progress records and referral. Career exploration should start with listening, faithful recording, team collaboration and privacy boundaries; the US task profile does not directly confer diagnostic or treatment authority in China, and the US wage and employment figures also include mental health counsellors.
